qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the battery positive connection point in the power distributor?
What screw size is used for the wiring harness on distributor connection?
What is the torque value for the wiring harness on distributor (2AZ)?
Which component types use the battery positive connection point specification?
What is the difference in torque between the battery positive connection and the wiring harness on distributor?
qa_pairs.answer: The battery positive connection requires 20 Nm while the wiring harness on distributor requires 10 Nm, a difference of 10 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What component designation is used for the wiring harness on distributor?
What section of the manual does this torque specification table belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 12-10 Engine Electrical Equipment, subsection 12 42 Wires to starter.

qa_pairs.question: Do both electrical connections use the same screw size?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both the battery positive connection point and wiring harness on distributor use M8 screws.
